title: Spacecraft radiator panel
line: A steady thermal FEA study of a spacecraft radiator panel rejecting 40 W to deep space by radiation.
description: Steady temperature of an aluminum spacecraft radiator panel (300 x 300 x 2 mm). Electronics on its back face dissipate 40 W into it, and its painted front face radiates to deep space at 3 K with an emissivity of 0.92. The study returns the panel temperature, which settles where radiated power equals the input.
thumbnailAlt: Temperature of an aluminum radiator panel radiating 40 W to space, solved in RunMat
